tools.name: bkg_me
tools.description: Show which salon the API key belongs to, its scopes and its rate limit. Use it first to confirm the connection. BKG API: GET /me.

tools.name: bkg_list_services
tools.description: List the services the salon sells (name, duration, price, category). BKG API: GET /services.

tools.name: bkg_get_service
tools.description: Get one service by id, with its duration, price and rules. BKG API: GET /services/{service_id}.

tools.name: bkg_list_staff
tools.description: List the staff members (employees) of the salon. BKG API: GET /staff.

tools.name: bkg_list_locations
tools.description: List the salon's locations (branches). BKG API: GET /locations.

tools.name: bkg_get_staff_schedule
tools.description: Get the planned working hours per day for staff, with days off and special days applied. Range: at most 62 days. BKG API: GET /staff/schedule.

tools.name: bkg_search_availability
tools.description: Find free booking times for a service on a day or a range of up to 14 days. Use it before bkg_create_booking. BKG API: GET /availability.

tools.name: bkg_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings, filtered by time range, status, client, staff or service. BKG API: GET /bookings.

tools.name: bkg_get_booking
tools.description: Get one booking by id: service, staff, location, time, status and price. BKG API: GET /bookings/{booking_id}.

tools.name: bkg_list_clients
tools.description: Search clients by name, email or phone, or list them. BKG API: GET /clients.

tools.name: bkg_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id: contact details and notes. BKG API: GET /clients/{client_id}.

tools.name: bkg_list_payments
tools.description: List payments, optionally for one booking or status. BKG API: GET /payments.

tools.name: bkg_create_booking
tools.description: Create a booking at a free time from bkg_search_availability. Writes to the salon's calendar. BKG API: POST /bookings.

tools.name: bkg_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel one booking. The salon's cancellation terms apply. BKG API: POST /bookings/{booking_id}/cancel.

tools.name: bkg_create_client
tools.description: Create a client record with contact details and notes. BKG API: POST /clients.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bkg_list_clients · Private data: bkg_me, bkg_get_client, bkg_create_client · Public sink: bkg_list_clients, bkg_create_booking, bkg_cancel_booking, bkg_create_client.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bkg_list_clients · Private data: bkg_me, bkg_get_client, bkg_create_client · Public sink: bkg_list_clients, bkg_create_booking, bkg_cancel_booking, bkg_create_client

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
